NEOW.talk.BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PLAGUE_B: You called for a physician. I fear you are beyond my care.
Something that survives long enough to spread.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER: A structure this old should have collapsed from infection long ago.
Stone remembers every sickness carried across it.
Then let me open the wound.
DARV.talk.BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PLAGUE_B: You look remarkably healthy. I distrust that.
Health is only the interval between symptoms.
PAEL.talk.BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PLAGUE_B: I have treated fevers kinder than this place.
Kindness has never cured the Spire.
TANX.talk.BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PLAGUE_B: Another collector. Tell me what disease you prize most.
The one that teaches its host to endure.
VAKUU.talk.BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PLAGUE_: The air around you is sterile. Unnaturally so.
Purity is merely another kind of poison.
OROBAS.talk.BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PLAGUE: I can smell old blood beneath the incense.
And I can smell the graves behind your mask.
NONUPEIPE.talk.BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PLA: Do not mistake the mask for fear of contagion.
No. It is fear of recognition.
TEZCATARA.talk.BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PLA: Your symptoms are fascinating. Terminal, but fascinating.
You speak as though you are not infected too.
Every physician is eventually a patient.
